SELECT meter.tenant_id, device.organization_id, meter.device_id, meter.parameter_id, organization.path AS organization_path FROM meter JOIN device ON device.id = meter.device_id AND device.tenant_id = meter.tenant_id JOIN organization ON organization.id = device.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = meter.tenant_id WHERE meter.id = #{meterId} AND meter.status = 'ACTIVE' AND device.status IN ('REGISTERED', 'ACTIVE') AND organization.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT device.tenant_id, organization.path AS organization_path FROM device JOIN organization ON organization.id = device.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = device.tenant_id WHERE device.id = #{deviceId} AND device.status IN ('REGISTERED', 'ACTIVE') AND organization.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_rule(id, tenant_id, organization_id, device_id, meter_id, parameter_id, code, display_name, value_selector, comparison, trigger_threshold, clear_threshold, severity, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{organizationId}, #{deviceId}, #{meterId}, #{parameterId}, #{code}, #{displayName}, #{valueSelector}, #{comparison}, #{triggerThreshold}, #{clearThreshold}, #{severity}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

mapper.select: SELECT alarm_incident.id, alarm_incident.tenant_id, alarm_incident.rule_id, alarm_incident.organization_id, alarm_incident.device_id, alarm_incident.meter_id, alarm_incident.parameter_id, alarm_incident.severity, alarm_incident.state, alarm_incident.trigger_value, alarm_incident.latest_value, alarm_incident.occurrence_count, alarm_incident.opened_at, alarm_incident.last_observed_at, alarm_incident.acknowledged_by, alarm_incident.acknowledged_at, alarm_incident.cleared_at, alarm_incident.version, alarm_incident.updated_at, NULL::text AS organization_path FROM alarm_incident WHERE alarm_incident.rule_id = #{ruleId} AND alarm_incident.meter_id = #{meterId} AND alarm_incident.state IN ('OPEN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED') FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_incident(id, tenant_id, rule_id, organization_id, device_id, meter_id, parameter_id, severity, state, trigger_value, latest_value, occurrence_count, opened_at, last_observed_at, acknowledged_by, acknowledged_at, cleared_at, version, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{ruleId}, #{organizationId}, #{deviceId}, #{meterId}, #{parameterId}, #{severity}, #{state}, #{triggerValue}, #{latestValue}, #{occurrenceCount}, #{openedAt}, #{lastObservedAt}, #{acknowledgedBy}, #{acknowledgedAt}, #{clearedAt}, #{version}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE alarm_incident SET state = #{incident.state}, latest_value = #{incident.latestValue}, occurrence_count = #{incident.occurrenceCount}, last_observed_at = #{incident.lastObservedAt}, acknowledged_by = #{incident.acknowledgedBy}, acknowledged_at = #{incident.acknowledgedAt}, cleared_at = #{incident.clearedAt}, version = #{incident.version}, updated_at = #{incident.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{incident.id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
